label: Case instance of the necessary-if-existent proposition G
term: some concrete GOD_4 exists (world proposition G)
definition: GodConcreteExists σ m is the world proposition (MProp) true at v when some x is GodConcretePresent σ m x v. It instantiates the stipulated scalar proposition G of NecessaryIfExistent (#437). As a world proposition it fixes no individual across worlds, so its box is de dicto (box_iff_deDicto: definitionally DeDicto of concrete GOD_4 presence).
note: Not Scott's essence-based NecessaryExistence and not Gödel's GodLike (DISAMB-NECESSARY keeps those senses distinct); no identification with a Gödel–Scott God is made. Analyst formulation, attribution deferred.
